name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum to a Common Paper agreement that governs AI features of a product, covering use of AI services, inputs and outputs, model training restrictions, and related disclaimers.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling or buying cloud software (SaaS), covering access and use, support, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A Data Processing Agreement governing how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including processor and subprocessor relationships, security, restricted transfers, and GDPR/UK GDPR compliance.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement giving an early customer (design partner) access to a product under development in exchange for feedback and participation in the design partner program.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA under which both parties may share confidential information for a stated purpose, covering permitted use, exceptions, term, and return or destruction of information.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: The cover page for the Mutual NDA, where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, jurisdiction, any modifications, and signatures.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, payment, trademark licensing, confidentiality, term and termination, and liability.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term agreement that lets a prospective customer trial or evaluate a product for a limited pilot period before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for providing professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, payment, intellectual property ownership, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms for a cloud service, covering target uptime and how it is calculated, support response times, and service credits when targets are missed.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing software that the customer installs and runs itself (on-premise or self-hosted), covering the license grant, support, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, and indemnification.
